{%- comment -%}
  Outputs FAQPage JSON-LD for product pages using sizing, shipping, and return-policy
  content already present on the PDP.

  Usage: {% render 'product-faq-schema', product: product %}
{%- endcomment -%}

{%- if product -%}
  {%- liquid
    assign has_size_option = false
    for option in product.options_with_values
      assign option_name = option.name | downcase
      if option_name contains 'size' or option_name contains 'talla' or option_name contains 'taille' or option_name contains 'tamano' or option_name contains 'tamanho'
        assign has_size_option = true
        break
      endif
    endfor

    assign faq_items = ''
    assign faq_delimiter = ''

    if has_size_option
      capture faq_items
        echo faq_items
        echo faq_delimiter
        echo '{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I choose the right size?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Use the Size Details chart on this page to compare measurements for the selected option. When available, the chart can be viewed in centimeters or inches."}}'
      endcapture
      assign faq_delimiter = ','
    endif

    assign shipping_label = 'products.additional_info.free_shipping_label' | t
    assign shipping_intro = 'products.additional_info.estimated_delivery' | t
    assign shipping_window = 'products.additional_info.standard_delivery_window' | t
    if shipping_label == blank or shipping_label contains 'translation missing'
      assign shipping_label = 'Shipping Options'
    endif
    if shipping_intro == blank or shipping_intro contains 'translation missing'
      assign shipping_intro = 'Estimated delivery:'
    endif
    if shipping_window == blank or shipping_window contains 'translation missing' or shipping_window contains 'business days'
      assign shipping_window = '12-16 days'
    endif

    capture shipping_answer
      echo shipping_label
      echo '. '
      echo shipping_intro
      echo ' '
      echo shipping_window
    endcapture
    assign shipping_answer = shipping_answer | strip | strip_newlines | replace: '  ', ' '

    capture faq_items
      echo faq_items
      echo faq_delimiter
      echo '{"@type":"Question","name":"How long does shipping take?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":'
      echo shipping_answer | json
      echo '}}'
    endcapture
    assign faq_delimiter = ','

    capture return_answer
      echo 'products.additional_info.return_policy_line_1' | t
      echo ' '
      echo 'products.additional_info.return_policy_line_2' | t
      echo ' '
      echo 'products.additional_info.return_policy_line_3' | t
      echo ' '
      echo 'products.additional_info.return_policy_line_4' | t
    endcapture
    assign return_answer = return_answer | strip | strip_newlines | replace: '  ', ' '

    capture faq_items
      echo faq_items
      echo faq_delimiter
      echo '{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the return policy?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":'
      echo return_answer | json
      echo '}}'
    endcapture
  -%}

  {%- if faq_items != blank -%}
    <script type="application/ld+json">
    {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      "mainEntity": [{{ faq_items }}]
    }
    </script>
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endif -%}
